remarks: Discover the perfect blend of space, style and maintenance-free living in this highly sought-after Woodridge Park Townhome. Offering over 2,500 square feet of living space, a highly sought after first-floor primary suite, and an exceptional floor plan designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining, this home checks all the boxes. A spacious private driveway and attached two-car garage set the stage for the inviting interior. The impressive great room features soaring ceilings and a dramatic gas fireplace, flowing seamlessly into the formal dining room. The fully applianced eat-in kitchen with a brand new dishwasher offers abundant cabinetry and a breakfast area. The first-floor primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a walk-in closet and spa-inspired full bath featuring an extended vanity, soaking tub and walk-in shower. A convenient first-floor laundry room and half bath add to the home's functionality. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms, each with a walk-in closet, share a second full bath. The full basement offers excellent storage and endless potential for future finishing. Enjoy added peace of mind with solid mechanicals, including central air. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a covered front porch and a private rear deck overlooking the yard with mature landscaping. Ideally situated in the desirable, walkable Woodridge Park community, this townhome offers easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, and everyday conveniences, all just minutes from the Village of Orchard Park. Enjoy the space, comfort and carefree lifestyle you have been looking for. Welcome Home to 142 Southwick Drive.
